post.caption:
6 workouts this week. 0 minutes for your heart. 🤍

Your watch tracks everything: steps, reps, calories. 32 minutes on the treadmill. The man next to you runs slower, no earphones, whispering “SubhanAllah… Alhamdulillah…” with every step. Then your watch buzzes: “Resting heart rate: 52. Excellent.” Your body: excellent. And your heart?

“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.” (13:28)

Before Maghrib today: five minutes of dhikr. Count it on your fingers.
